case.name: window_frame_after_scan
case.sql: SELECT count(*),sum(x) FROM (SELECT sum(x) OVER (PARTITION BY grp ORDER BY seq DESC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS x FROM (SELECT unicode(substr(CAST(t.payload AS TEXT),-1,1)) AS x,t.seq AS seq,t.grp AS grp FROM t WHERE t.seq%2=0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM u WHERE u.id=t.seq AND u.v>=t.v)));
case.prepare: SELECT sum(length(payload)),sum(v) FROM t NOT INDEXED;
